name: Safety Inspector
texts: You may spend 3 XP as an additional cost to play me. When you play me, each player must kill one of their units. If you paid my additional cost, you don't kill a unit this way.
manual: You may spend 3 XP as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, each player must kill one of their units.
If you paid my additional cost, you don't kill a unit this way.
